policies.title: Israeli ordinary passports: visa issued on arrival
policies.summary: The current statutory schedule requires a visa for Israeli nationals, while the current Department Category Two list and official Malawi mission guidance expressly supply the compatible border-issued route. The live portal selector's no-visa result cannot override the replacement Schedule.
conditions: This is an ordinary Israeli passport, short-visitor route only. Government Notice No. 1's listed passport exceptions concern diplomatic or service passports, not this ordinary-passport policy.
The traveller may board without a pre-departure visa and obtains the visa at the port of entry. Final admission remains subject to Malawi Immigration laws and regulations.
The eVisa route is an optional alternative. The status is visa_on_arrival because the current mission guidance states where the visa is issued.

policies.title: Samoan, Tuvaluan and Nauruan ordinary passports: electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Government Notice No. 1 replaces the former 2024 exemption schedule and requires visas for Samoa, Tuvalu and Nauru. The current official mission process then supplies the actual pre-travel electronic visa application and emailed PDF issuance route.
conditions: For ordinary passports and a short visit only. Samoa, Tuvalu and Nauru are not in the replacement named exemption list and are not SADC or COMESA nationality exemptions.
Apply through the official portal; after Department approval the eVisa PDF is received by email or account, printed, and shown at the port of entry.
The live no-visa selector configuration conflicts with the replacement statutory schedule. It is not an express amendment, Gazette instrument, or authority to disregard the visa requirement.

application.label: Malawi Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services eVisa portal
steps: Create an account and complete the electronic visa application using the ordinary passport and travel details.
Upload the requested supporting material and make the online fee payment.
After Department approval, receive and print the eVisa PDF before travel and present it at entry.
